name: gunslinger
note: Joint positions are in model space, measured off gunslinger.12k.glb by
slicing the point cloud into 0.05 horizontal slabs and clustering each
slab in x (Y up, height 2.0, feet at y=-1.0).
The character faces +Z — confirmed numerically: at the sole the foot spans
z -0.17..+0.10 while the ankle above it sits at z -0.17..-0.05, so the toes
point +Z. Its right hand is therefore on -X.
Unlike the Necromancer this model is a lean skeleton: the torso core sits
well back at z -0.11, the head hangs forward at z 0.00, and the arms hang
outward from x +/-0.17 at the shoulder to x +/-0.34 at the hands, which are
down near knee height. A revolver hangs from each hand.
Bone names match necromancer.rig.json so one set of pose curves drives both.

joints.comment: Runs all the way from the waist to the collar. Greedy, so the ribcage and vest stay whole instead of being claimed by the thighs.
joints.name: torso

joints.comment: Stops at the collar and runs greedy so the wide hat brim at y 0.90..0.95 comes with the skull instead of staying on the torso.
joints.name: head

overrides.comment: Right revolver. It hangs from the hand down to y -0.55 and forward to z +0.21, which puts its muzzle nearer the shin than the forearm that holds it. The box is bounded at x -0.27 so it cannot reach the leg, which lives at x -0.15..-0.03.
